study.question: Does explicitly preserving same-event encoded category AND brand target matching improve beyond separate field/action counts and recency? Observed target-match count features outperform activity support (r0000-match_count 0.616754 vs r0000-support_count 0.613319), and aligned recency is provisionally best (r0001-aligned_time 0.617149). Its explicit branch discards cross-field event association; whether that association is nonredundant and predictive is unmeasured.
study.hypothesis: Among the supplied causal 128-event histories, simultaneous category and brand matches carry target-specific evidence that separate marginal counts and decay masses do not expose directly. Four per-action conjunction counts and four decayed conjunction masses may provide a useful low-cost readout beyond the existing learned attention. This is a prospective hypothesis, not established mechanism evidence or a priority claim.

nearest_work.difference: Inherits target-conditioned attention concept. This local reference uses normalized softmax weights, unlike the paper, and adds explicit encoded field statistics; it is not an exact DIN reproduction.

DGIN already combines grouped counts, dynamics and candidate-related behavior. Here only supplied category/brand/action/age tensors are used: no lifelong item grouping or item identity. The local contrast is exact event conjunction versus pair-valid marginal replacement, not a claim that counts are new.

TIN explicitly models semantic-temporal interactions. The one-day exponential kernel is inherited here; the intervention is a category/brand conjunction readout, without TIN temporal attention/representation modules or a temporal novelty claim.

EDIN/DINMP already summarizes repeated behaviors with count/time/category and partitions interests. This study keeps the frozen event representation and attention, adding eight deterministic conjunction statistics with matched replacements. No sparse-history compression or partition architecture is reproduced. Broader novelty remains unverified.

study.proposed_difference: Append eight transformed features to the existing sixteen. For each action, restrict to valid history category AND brand (mask and both encoded IDs >0). Let S be count, U=sum decay, Cc/Cb target-equality marginal counts, Wc/Wb corresponding decay masses, J=count of simultaneous target equality and K=its decay mass. Joint mode appends [J,K]; factorized mode [Cc*Cb/max(S,1), Wc*(Wb/U_safe), where U_safe=U if U>0 else 1] with exactly zero when U=0; duplicate mode appends existing category [C,W]; support mode appends [S,U]. Joint zero target IDs never match. All compute all quantities; same-event association is the sole feature replacement under test. All four add 8*128=1024 parameters to parent, expected total 17133347, dense 54659. The factorized decay value is a conditional-independence construction under decay-weighted event sampling, not an exact uniform-permutation expectation. No new performance, scientific novelty, independent validation or latency gain is asserted.
predictions: Primary predeclared comparison: joint_pair minus factorized_pair full-population validation AUC >0, with joint_pair also exceeding parent and duplicate_pair; mark a direction practically promising if each improvement is at least 0.0002 and Logloss is no worse. Support-pair performance must also be examined before target-specific attribution.

Diagnostics should show nonzero |J-Cc*Cb/S| or |K-Wc*Wb/U| in at least some action cells. If nearly always zero, the representation distinction lacks local opportunity. Count these only on supplied histories, not full lifetime behavior.

For a promising direction, repeat joint, factorized, duplicate, and incumbent with paired seeds 42,43,44 and include support if consequential. Report every seed and mean difference; a sign reversal or null mean weakens the hypothesis. Bootstrap only if the authorized host later supplies paired user-cluster support; no confidence interval is invented.

Parameter shapes and initialization order are equal across four new variants. Measured wall, GPU allocation, peak memory, throughput and batch p50/p95 latency must be reported; expected wall cost within 10 percent of incumbent is a prediction, not an efficiency result.
falsifiers: Joint fails to beat factorized and duplicate controls on primary AUC, or has worse Logloss: no supported incremental joint-readout gain, even if parent is beaten.
Support is as good as joint: target-specific conjunction is not isolated from opportunity/availability information.
Near-zero joint-versus-marginal diagnostic difference, or overwhelming joint sparsity, falsifies the proposed local opportunity but not the general value of field interactions elsewhere.
Paired-seed differences vanish or reverse, or matched measured cost is materially worse: the preliminary accuracy/efficiency explanation is not sustained.
Any finite-output/API/information-boundary failure is an implementation failure, charged and retained, not scientific counterevidence.
alternative_explanations: One seed initially; matching RNG and shape does not make optimization trajectories identical.
Factorization changes the statistical distribution and feature conditioning, not just semantic information; interpret replacement support narrowly.
Encoded category/brand conjunction is neither item identity nor guaranteed semantic equality; redundancy, missingness, hashing and rare actions may erase utility.
Learned attention already has event-level fields, so a gain supports accessible explicit readout, not impossibility of learning joint association.
The first 512 diagnostics are descriptive; full-population effects and paired user-cluster confidence intervals are unavailable locally.
Extra MLP capacity or easier marginal-product parameterization could explain an improvement over parent; use duplicate and factorized controls.
The publisher static snapshots have undocumented as-of dates, so causal history compliance does not establish production point-in-time validity.
No test assessment is available in this runtime; validation reuse and multiple comparisons limit generalization claims.
